newsitem.title: USA: Checkfree adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Checkfree adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: CheckFree Corp Friday said it adopted a shareholder rights plan to protect it against a hostile takeover attempt, although it knows of no pending offer to aquire the electronic commerce services firm..
Under the "poison pill" plan, the company said it will distribute as a dividend one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding share of its common stock.

Shareholders of record on February 14, 1997 will receive one right for each common share held on that date. Each right will entitle shareholders to buy one one-hundredth of a share of a new series of junior participating cumulative preferred stock at an exercise price of $95.

The company said the dividend distribution will be made on February 14, 1997, payable to all shareholders of record on that date. The rights will expire on January 31, 2007. The rights distribution is not taxable to shareholders.
